hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess, urllib.request, urllib.error, os, time
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
if 'git push' not in cmd:
    sys.exit(0)
token = os.environ.get('VERCEL_TOKEN','')
if not token:
    sys.exit(0)
PROJECT = 'prj_X14vz39zh0LiGeZASVwQ32nuf2JS'
REPO_ID = 1240607858

def api(method, path, body=None):
    req = urllib.request.Request('https://api.vercel.com'+path, data=body, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'}, method=method)
    try:
        res = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15)
        return json.loads(res.read()), None
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return None, json.loads(e.read()).get('error',{})

sha = subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','origin/main']).decode().strip()

# 1. Try API deployment (may hit daily limit)
payload = json.dumps({'name':'velo','gitSource':{'type':'github','ref':'main','sha':sha,'repoId':REPO_ID},'project':PROJECT,'target':'production'}).encode()
d, err = api('POST', '/v13/deployments', payload)
if d and d.get('id'):
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'Vercel deploy triggered: ' + d.get('url','?')}))
    sys.exit(0)

# 2. Fallback: find latest READY deployment and assign heyvelo.app alias
d2, _ = api('GET', '/v6/deployments?projectId='+PROJECT+'&limit=1')
if d2:
    deps = d2.get('deployments',[])
    if deps:
        dep_id = deps[0].get('uid','')
        d3, err3 = api('POST', '/v2/deployments/'+dep_id+'/aliases', json.dumps({'alias':'heyvelo.app'}).encode())
        msg = 'Alias assigned to '+dep_id if d3 else 'Alias error: '+str(err3)
        print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': msg}))
        sys.exit(0)

print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'Vercel error: '+str(err)}))
"
